(3 points) We saw that for a given decoder timestep $t$, the attention weights over the $S$ encoder states (timesteps) are constrained to sum up to 1 (i.e., $\sum_{s=1}^S \alpha_{ts} = 1$). However, there is no constraint on how the attention weights behave across timesteps.
